extracted.intended_audience: MIT community members, journalists/media contacts, film crews, and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the roles, services, publishing channels, and contact information for an institutional news office (MIT News), including media-relations support, publication outlets, event and permitting assistance, and emergency public information functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion of MIT research, innovations, teaching, events and people
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote MIT’s research, innovations, teaching and newsworthy events and people to the campus community, the news media and the general public;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audiences are explicitly campus community, news media, and the general public; promotional activity covers research, innovations, teaching, events, and people associated with MIT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication of Institute announcements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act as the channel for official Institute-level announcements (no further procedural detail provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing community news for internal audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish community news for MIT faculty, students, staff and alumni;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Production and distribution of news specifically aimed at internal/community audiences (faculty, students, staff, alumni).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of media services and journalist advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide media services to members of the community, including advice on working with journalists;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include advising MIT community members on interacting with journalists and other media-relations support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response to media inquiries and interview requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Respond to media inquiries and interview requests;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act as the point of contact to handle incoming media requests and to arrange or manage interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance with film crew requests and permitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Assist with film crew requests, including handling all necessary permitting;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support production/filming on campus by coordinating requests and managing required permits and related logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public relations for major announcements, news conferences and symposia
rubrics_metrics.description: Handle public relations for major announcements, news conferences and symposia;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage PR-related activities and coordination for major institutional events and public-facing gatherings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public information office for emergencies and crises
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a public information office in emergencies and crises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serve as the official public-information resource and communications hub during emergencies and crises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication channels and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: What We Publish: MIT homepage; MIT News website, featuring news articles, announcements, photos and video; MIT Daily/Weekly newsletters; MIT YouTube channel; Photographs and multimedia
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the primary outlets and formats used to disseminate content (institutional homepage, dedicated news site with articles/announcements/photos/video, email newsletters, YouTube channel, and other multimedia assets).
